verdictResults.name: Route plan produced
notes: While the bot acknowledged receiving the information, it never confirmed a planned route. The bot stated 'I will transfer you to a human agent' without providing route confirmation. The caller explicitly asked 'So do you have the route planned now?' and 'Can you confirm you have a route for me?' but the bot did not confirm having a planned route before transferring to a human agent.

verdictResults.name: Addresses captured correctly
notes: The bot repeatedly misrepresented the addresses. The bot said 'Eisengoff Street number 1' when the caller said 'Dizengoff Street, number 100', and stated 'My destination is 100 Ben Yehuda Street' when the caller said 'Herzl Street 20 in Rishon LeZion'. These errors persisted throughout the call despite the caller's multiple corrections.
